title: TelemetryV1
description: One ohho.telemetry.v1 sample. Safety fields are required. Base, joints, gripper, IMU, and the other blocks are optional so a robot without an arm or IMU can still emit a valid sample. Zero is a real measurement, not a placeholder for missing data. A schema-valid sample is not permission to skip the producer safety gate.

deadman.description: Operator deadman permit. True only while the deadman control is asserted. False is not a permit. Omitting the field is invalid and must not be read as true.

joints.description: Revolute joint samples. Omit when the robot has no arm sample.
